tool_description: Audits Python and Node.js dependencies across all projects under C:/Users/beren. Checks for outdated packages, security vulnerabilities, version conflicts between projects, and missing or unused imports.

available_commands.description: Discover all projects with requirements.txt or package.json files
Check for outdated Python packages by comparing pinned versions against PyPI latest
Scan for known security vulnerabilities using pip-audit
Find packages pinned at different versions across multiple projects
Scan Python files for imports and compare against requirements.txt to find missing or unused packages
Run npm audit on Node.js projects
Run a complete audit: outdated, vulnerabilities, conflicts and missing packages

tool_usage_guidance: Use full_audit for a comprehensive overview of a single project
Use check_outdated with check_all=true to scan all projects (slow — queries PyPI per package)
check_vulnerabilities requires pip-audit: pip install pip-audit
check_conflicts compares requirements.txt files across all discovered projects
check_missing scans .py imports and flags packages not in requirements.txt
audit_npm requires npm to be on PATH
proactive_triggers: When user asks 'are my packages up to date?' or 'any security issues?'
When user asks to audit a specific project
When user asks about version conflicts between projects
When user asks what packages might be missing from requirements.txt

metadata.notes: check_outdated queries PyPI for each package — may be slow on large projects. Disabled by default to avoid startup overhead.
